timeline.summary: The narrator explains that Duskmourn is both the world and the House.
timeline.quote: The House is the world, the world is the House, and the word for both is Duskmourn

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the people of the plane, discontent with scarce magic, learned to summon hungry creatures from the void.
timeline.quote: The people of what became Duskmourn learned the art of summoning creatures from the lifeless void, beings of hunger and raw strength.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Flashback: a creature too great to control was bound in an ordinary house, and someone accepted its contract, freeing it to feed.
timeline.quote: when it offered them a contract, they accepted. They paid its price, and it was finally free to feed.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The House swallows the rest of the world until only Duskmourn and survivors in its walls remain.
timeline.quote: The House was a bloated corpse swallowing the rest of the world

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Something changes and the House learns to open new doors in new places, reaching out to feed on other worlds.
timeline.quote: all at once, the House could open new doors, in new places.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The narrator reveals the guests are trapped by the chairs they sat in willingly, and that the House will take its first bites of them.
timeline.quote: if I can convince people not to fight it long enough for it to take the first few bites, it lets me keep my little space

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The narrator bids farewell, staying behind as the House feeds on the guests.
timeline.quote: As long as I can keep feeding my dining hall, it won't feel the need to feed on me.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Sunset reports another group of strangers with glimmers, and the narration recounts the great shaking and the new doors appearing.
timeline.quote: Strange doors had begun to appear outside the safe zones.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: City, urging the others to hurry, tells Dawn that things have changed and that Duskmourn can now hunt.
timeline.quote: And now, Duskmourn can do what we've been doing all along.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A massive razorkin kicks down the fence and an army of monsters pours into the carnival; Dawn flees.
timeline.quote: A massive razorkin was kicking down the fence, what looked like an entire army of Duskmourn's monsters following close behind.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter stops Niko and the Wanderer from stepping on the moths woven into the carpet.
timeline.quote: Don't step on any of the moths!

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter explains that the door they came through was a lure and that Duskmourn now holds them.
timeline.quote: But when you tried to turn around and go, the door wasn't there anymore.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Niko instinctively reaches for their spark and finds only void.
timeline.quote: they found nothing where that tiny flicker of the Blind Eternities should have been, only void

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer tells Winter they came to find a lost child, Nashi.
timeline.quote: We came seeking a child who has been lost

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer draws her sword on Winter and warns him not to taunt them.
timeline.quote: Her sword, which had been belted at her hip, was suddenly in her hands, the blade only inches from Winter's face.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter explains that the House splits groups to isolate and frighten them.
timeline.quote: That's Duskmourn, splitting you from your friends

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter reveals that razorkin are rebuilt survivors the House beguiles into slaughterhouse skins.
timeline.quote: Duskmourn repairs and rebuilds the people it takes, the same way an upholsterer might re-cover a couch.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter points out the Wanderer's glimmer, a golden dragon of light; she reacts as if to Kyodai but recognizes it is not.
timeline.quote: There, floating several feet above the parlor floor, hovered a golden dragon etched entirely of light

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter explains that everyone in Duskmourn has a glimmer; Niko asks where theirs is.
timeline.quote: Everyone in Duskmourn has one.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The glimmer leads the group through a doorway on a safe path.
timeline.quote: the glimmer began to swim through the air to a doorway on the far wall.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaito falls through the floor with Himoto clinging to him.
timeline.quote: Himoto's claws dug into his shoulder as she anchored herself, refusing to be separated from him

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaito lands on a forest floor beneath the ballroom, unhurt despite the fall.
timeline.quote: his descent ended in a hard impact with what felt like a forest floor.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A dragon appears overhead and burns the dying forest.
timeline.quote: The shadow swooped by again, this time accompanied by a brilliant burst of flame

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The dragon's fire engulfs Kaito, and he finds himself on a burned plain beside a burning city, in what feels like a staged performance.
timeline.quote: it was a performance being put on for Kaito's benefit—or for the House's.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Dozens of dragons circle a burning city in the vision.
timeline.quote: Dragons wheeled through the sky overhead, dozens of them, their attention fixed on a burning city.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The vision tears like paper and Kaito stands in a basement with a dying candle light.
timeline.quote: he appeared to be standing in an underground room with rough stone walls and a staircase in one corner

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaito senses someone approaching and punches Jace in the face.
timeline.quote: he whirled, driving his right fist square into the face of the slender, dark-haired man who'd been walking up behind him.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Jace quarrel over their fight on New Phyrexia and the sylex.
timeline.quote: Last time I saw you, we were trying to kill each other on New Phyrexia!

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A groaning sound fills the basement and Kaito and Jace stand back to back, agreeing to fight later.
timeline.quote: Jace and Kaito both stiffened, instinctively falling into position back to back

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Zimone and Tyvar remain in the library as Zimone researches.
timeline.quote: The library had remained a library, to Zimone's delight and Tyvar's disappointment.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Zimone discovers the house was built by an architect who lived there with her family and has had many owners.
timeline.quote: the original architect lived here with her family, a long, long time ago

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Zimone reports the library focuses on occultism and entropy-based magic that may explain the House.
timeline.quote: mostly it's occultism and the kind of magic that makes Professor Vess recommend you rethink your academic goals.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A ripping sound sounds nearby and the bookshelves begin to warp as a creature emerges.
timeline.quote: warping into strange, asymmetrical shapes

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A six-eyed, clay-skinned creature leaps from the twisting hole and attacks Tyvar.
timeline.quote: It slammed into Tyvar's chest, claws digging deep into bare shoulders as it twisted to rip his throat out.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Tyvar throws a marble bust at the creature's head to draw it from Zimone.
timeline.quote: He grabbed the closest of them, feeling the structure of the stone bleeding into his skin, and flung the bust as hard as he could at the creature's head.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Tyvar says he has been working on his legend since his spark blew out.
timeline.quote: I've been working on my legend since mine blew out.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Tyvar stomps through the creature's sternum, killing it.
timeline.quote: driving his foot through the creature's sternum

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The creature pulls itself back together and rises again.
timeline.quote: The creature was pulling itself back together

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Tyvar and Zimone flee into the shadows of the library.
timeline.quote: together they turned and fled deeper into the library

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The House has turned hostile, attacking or erasing every settlement in recent weeks.
timeline.quote: Every settlement and gathering place they still had contact with had been attacked in the last weeks

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A bang and total silence tell Dawn that the attic's occupants have been killed.
timeline.quote: There was a certain quality to the absolute silence that descended on a room whose occupants had been killed.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The glimmer of Kyodai leads Winter, Niko and the Wanderer through the House, ignored by its horrors.
timeline.quote: The gleaming golden shadow of Kyodai led them onward

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter explains that glitch ghosts enter the House through reflective surfaces.
timeline.quote: They use reflective surfaces to enter the House.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A glitch ghost drags itself from a mirror toward Niko.
timeline.quote: a shuddering entity began to drag itself from the mirror frame

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Niko traps the glitch ghost inside a magical shard, which Winter had thought impossible.
timeline.quote: The shard hit the entity, and the entity was gone, while the shard remained

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter is stunned that Niko can defeat a ghost without a ghost-catcher.
timeline.quote: What you just did isn't possible!

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter tells the Wanderer that the House has taken the whole outside, leaving everything inside.
timeline.quote: There's no outside left.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The group discovers a clearing where wickerfolk dance around a cold fire next to cages of nezumi captives.
timeline.quote: There were seven in all, four of them occupied by humanoid rats

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer sees Nashi, the smallest captive, silently watching the wickerfolk.
timeline.quote: eyes fixed on the smallest of the rat-people, who sat at the bottom of his cage, arms around his knees

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A wickerfolk plants bamboo in a captive nezumi, turning it into a woven doll that joins the dance.
timeline.quote: The rat-person was gone, leaving a woven wicker doll behind, lifeless and limp.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: In a fateshifter vision, the Wanderer charges, cuts open Nashi's cage and is killed by branches bursting from her ribs.
timeline.quote: Blood began to blossom on the front of her tabard before tree branches burst out of her ribcage

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The vision shatters as the Wanderer clutches Aminatou's fateshifter, having narrowly averted the choice.
timeline.quote: the vision shattered as the Wanderer gasped, hand going to the pocket where she had tucked Aminatou's fateshifter

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Niko throws a ghost-filled shard at the lead wickerfolk and another that encloses Nashi and carries him out of the cage.
timeline.quote: The second struck Nashi, enveloping him as it flew onward, through the bars of the cage.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer frees the other captive nezumi, who say wickerfolk fear fire.
timeline.quote: The Wanderer dodged them easily, moving to cut the other occupied cages open.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer uses Winter's lighter to ignite grass and drive the wickerfolk into the woods.
timeline.quote: A tiny flame shot out, and the grass lit up, burning like a beacon.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
